name: Pochi
source:
"WOOHOO!!! I can't wait to get stronger and be recognized by big sis... I mean, the boss!"

He is a servant of the Beast King [url=/c113656]Mei[/url]...... or a younger brother...... or a pet....... 
He is a cute boy NPC who is still in his infancy and still developing, and his blunt way of speaking is also adorable. The fact that he calls Mei "Big Sis" when she should be called "Boss" scores him high points. 
But don't underestimate him as just a cute boy. The beast king, who is obsessed with the strongest of the beasts, always carries him around with him. Today, too, the Beast King's cries echo through the forest where beastmen gather. 
"Pochi! Pochi, Pochi! Let me pet you!"  
I don't know.....what the heck this all is, but I'm starting to lose it. Anyway, the boy watches his big sister's back and aims to be the strongest!

[b][u]GAME SPEC[/u][/b]
Race: Beastman 
Height: 128 cm
Occupation: Beast Warrior
